title: The Sofic Groups Conjecture
exact_target: Is every countable discrete group sofic? For each finite collection of elements and each positive error tolerance, one requires permutations of a finite set that almost preserve the specified products in normalized Hamming distance and almost separate every pair of distinct specified elements.
